4357-american-fairy-tales.title: American Fairy Tales
4357-american-fairy-tales.creator: L. Frank Baum
4357-american-fairy-tales.description: A book by L. Frank Baum. Around the walls were rows of boxes and trunks, piles of old carpeting, pieces of damaged furniture, bundles of discarded clothing and other odds and ends of more or less value. Every well-regulated house has an attic of this sort, so I need not describe it.

arxiv-2012-02276.title: A feedforward neural network for modeling of average pressure frequency response
arxiv-2012-02276.description: Abstract . The Helmholtz equation has been used for modeling the sound pressure field under a harmonic load. Computing harmonic sound pressure fields by means of solving Helmholtz equation can quickly become unfeasible if one wants to study many different geometries for ranges of frequencies.

arxiv-2107-02598.title: Morphogenesis and self-organization of persistent filaments confined within flexible biopolymeric shells
arxiv-2107-02598.creator: Maxime M. C. Tortora, Daniel Jost
arxiv-2107-02598.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Maxime M. C. Tortora, Daniel Jost. We systematically explore the self-assembly of semi-flexible polymers in deformable spherical confinement across a wide regime of chain stiffness, contour lengths and packing fractions by means of coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations. Compliant, DNA-like filaments are found to undergo a continuous crossover from two distinct surface-ordered quadrupolar states, both characterized by tetrahedral patterns of topological defects, to either longitudinal or latitudinal bipolar structures with increasing polymer concentrations.

arxiv-2302-01871.creator: Tomás L. Gómez, Andres Fernández Herrero, Alfonso Zamora
arxiv-2302-01871.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tomás L. Gómez, Andres Fernández Herrero, Alfonso Zamora. In this survey we provide an overview of some recent developments in the construction of moduli spaces using stack-theoretic techniques. We will also explain the analogue of Harder-Narasimhan stratifications for general stacks, known as Θ \Theta -stratifications. As an application of the ideas exposed here, we address the moduli problem of principal bundles over higher dimensional projective varieties, as well as its different compactifications by the so-called principal ρ \rho -sheaves.

arxiv-2402-11648.title: Iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator With Variational Equation-Based Discretization
arxiv-2402-11648.creator: Katsuya Shigematsu, Hikaru Hoshino, Eiko Furutani
arxiv-2402-11648.description: Abstract This paper discusses discretization methods for implementing nonlinear model predictive controllers using Iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (ILQR). Finite-difference approximations are mostly used to derive a discrete-time state equation from the original continuous-time model. However, the timestep of the discretization is sometimes restricted to be small to suppress the approximation error.

arxiv-2403-13500.title: The Galactic latitude dependency of Faraday complexity in the S-PASS/ATCA RM catalogue
arxiv-2403-13500.creator: S. Ranchod, S. A Mao, R. Deane, S. S. Sridhar, A. Damas-Segovia, J. D. Livingston, Y. K. Ma
arxiv-2403-13500.description: Abstract The S-band Polarisation All Sky Survey (SPASS/ATCA) rotation measure (RM) catalogue is the largest broadband RM catalogue to date, increasing the RM density in the sparse southern sky. Through analysis of this catalogue, we report a latitude dependency of the Faraday complexity of polarised sources in this catalogue within 10 ∘ of the Galactic plane towards the inner Galaxy.

arxiv-2404-00446.title: Towards a Semantic Characterisation of Global Type Well-formedness
arxiv-2404-00446.creator: Ilaria Castellani, Paola Giannini
arxiv-2404-00446.description: Abstract We address the question of characterising the well-formedness properties of multiparty session types semantically, i.e., as properties of the semantic model used to interpret types. Choosing Prime Event Structures (PESs) as our semantic model, we present semantic counterparts for the two properties that underpin global type well-formedness, namely projectability and boundedness, in this model.

arxiv-2505-12474.creator: Weixiao Zhou, Junnan Zhu, Gengyao Li, Xianfu Cheng, Xinnian Liang, Feifei Zhai, Zhoujun Li
arxiv-2505-12474.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the performance of LLMs on a new task that requires combining discussion with background knowledge for summarization. This aims to address the limitation of outside observer confusion in existing dialogue summarization systems due to their reliance solely on discussion information.

arxiv-2601-05648.title: Open World Knowledge Aided Single-Cell Foundation Model with Robust Cross-Modal Cell-Language Pre-training
arxiv-2601-05648.creator: Haoran Wang, Xuanyi Zhang, Shuangsang Fang, Longke Ran, Ziqing Deng, Yong Zhang, Yuxiang Li, Shaoshuai Li
arxiv-2601-05648.description: Abstract Recent advancements in single-cell multi-omics, particularly RNA-seq, have provided profound insights into cellular heterogeneity and gene regulation. While pre-trained language model (PLM) paradigm based single-cell foundation models have shown promise, they remain constrained by insufficient integration of in-depth individual profiles and neglecting the influence of noise within multi-modal data.

pmc-10618661.title: Association of the number of remaining teeth with kidney function in community-dwelling healthy older adults: a cross-sectional study
pmc-10618661.creator: Yui Nanba, Yuhei Matsuda, Satsuki Watanabe, Mayu Takeda, Takafumi Abe, Kazumichi Tominaga, Minoru Isomura, Takahiro Kanno
pmc-10618661.description: ObjectivesAlthough a few studies have investigated the relationship between kidney and oral function (number of remaining teeth), their results remain inconclusive. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate the relationship between kidney function and oral health in community-dwelling healthy elderlies and examine the factors associated with kidney function.

pmc-10624572.title: Deep brain stimulation in a patient with progressive myoclonic epilepsy and ataxia due to potassium channel mutation (MEAK). A case report and review of the literature
pmc-10624572.creator: Michał Sobstyl, Nina Kożuch, Magdalena Iwaniuk-Gugała, Angelika Stapińska-Syniec, Magdalena Konopko, Paweł Jezierski
pmc-10624572.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Highlights:•Progressive myoclonic epilepsy is characterized by myoclonus and generalized tonic-clonic seizures.•The KCNC1 mutation is responsible for specific clinical phenotype of progressive myoclonic epilepsy.•Subthalamic nucleus/substantia nigra deep brain stimulation might be the treatment for pharmacological-refractory myoclonus and drug-resistant epilepsy. Introduction

Progressive myoclonic epilepsy (PME) includes a variety of phenotypically similar, but genetically heterogeneous syndromes with common clinical features such as myoclonus, drug-resistant seizures, intention tremor, ataxia, and cognitive impairment [1].

pmc-10737702.title: REDUCING BENEVOLENT AGEISM AMONG UNDERGRADUATE HEALTHCARE MAJOR STUDENTS IN A GERONTOLOGY CLASS
pmc-10737702.creator: Jiawei Cao, Jialin Cui
pmc-10737702.description: While gerontologists have devoted continuing efforts to combating ageism through education and interventions, benevolent ageism remains to be a more subtle and covert concept to understand and recognize. This study aims to examine the effectiveness of an innovative pedagogy to reduce benevolent ageism among undergraduates majoring in healthcare with an aging focus.

pmc-11350559.title: How traditional Chinese exercise (Daoyin) can help COVID-19 patients relieve psychological symptoms: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11350559.creator: Naifan Duan, Feng Chen, Yalan Li, Linqiong Zhou, Xing Zhang, Guihua Xu, Wei Zhang
pmc-11350559.description: ObjectiveThe mental health issues of individuals with coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) are currently widespread. Traditional Chinese exercise (Daoyin) plays an important role in relieving patients’ psychological problems. This study aims to assess the efficacy of Daoyin in mitigating mental health issues among individuals diagnosed with COVID-19.

pmc-11390090.title: Management of iatrogenic airway bleeding with flexible bronchoscopy: Evidence or experience-based?
pmc-11390090.creator: Oğuz KARCIOĞLU, Ziya Toros SELÇUK
pmc-11390090.description: ABSTRACT Management of iatrogenic airway bleeding with flexible bronchoscopy: Evidence or experience-based? Iatrogenic bleeding during bronchoscopy may lead to early termination, insuf- ficient sample collection, decreased diagnostic accuracy, and even death. Unlike rigid bronchoscopy, the management of bleeding during flexible fibe- roptic bronchoscopy does not allow the use of methods such as cautery, direct pressure, etc.

pmc-11400973.title: IOL power calculation in long eyes: Selection of the best axial length adjustement factor using the most common formulas
pmc-11400973.creator: Ferdinando Cione, Maddalena De Bernardo, Ilenia Di Paola, Alessandro Caputo, Mario Graziano, Nicola Rosa
pmc-11400973.description: PurposeComparing IOL power calculation formulas in long eyes (AL≥26.00 mm) to find the best axial length (AL) adjustment/IOL power calculation formula combination.DesignRetrospective, comparative, case-series.ParticipantsPatients with long eyes that underwent cataract surgery.Methodsfive-hundred-fifty-four eyes of 554 patients were examined before and after standard phacoemulsification without complications. Eyes were subdivided in 3 groups according to AL: 26.00≤AL<28.00 mm, 28.00≤AL<30.00 mm, AL≥30.00 mm.

pmc-11409387.title: Assessing the effect of anthocyanins through diet and supplementation on cognitive function in older adults at risk for dementia: protocol for a randomised controlled trial
pmc-11409387.creator: Vinicius do Rosario, Elnaz Lorzadeh, Henry Brodaty, Kaarin J Anstey, Karina Chan, Steven Roodenrys, Katherine Kent, Vida Bliokas, Lyn Phillipson, Katrina Weston-Green, Monique E Francois, Xiaotao Jiang, Jenson George, Jan Potter, Marijka J Batterham, Karen Charlton
pmc-11409387.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). IntroductionPromising evidence is emerging for the procognitive, anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective properties of dietary flavonoids, particularly anthocyanins that provide red, purple and blue plant pigments.Methods and analysisThe ‘Food for Thought’ study is a multicentre, 6-month randomised, parallel 3-arm clinical trial. Its primary aim is to investigate whether anthocyanin consumption, either through diet or supplementation, can prevent memory loss progression and improve inflammatory and cardiovascular health in older adults at risk for dementia.

pmc-11476965.title: Expression Profiling of Coding and Noncoding RNAs in the Endometrium of Patients with Endometriosis
pmc-11476965.creator: Mi Ran Choi, Hye Jin Chang, Jeong-Hyeon Heo, Sun Hyung Yum, Eunae Jo, Miran Kim, Sang-Rae Lee
pmc-11476965.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The aim of this study was to identify differentially expressed lncRNAs (DElncRNAs) and mRNAs (DEmRNAs) in the endometrium of individuals with and without endometriosis (EMS) during the proliferative (P) and secretory (S) phases of the menstrual cycle. Tissues were obtained from 18 control (CT; P-phase [pCT], n = 8; S-phase [sCT], n = 13) and 23 EMS patients (P-phase [pEMS], n = 13; S-phase [sEMS], n = 12). DElncRNAs and DEmRNAs were analyzed using total RNA-sequencing.

pmc-11647112.title: Malignant melanoma developing in a pre-existing cutaneous neurofibroma from a patient with neurofibromatosis type 1
pmc-11647112.creator: Stefanie L. Moye, Ariel Knowles, Travis Vandergriff, Lu Q. Le
pmc-11647112.description: ngs include café-au-lait macules, axillary freckling, and cutaneous neurofibromas (cNFs). cNFs appear in nearly every patient with NF1 and do not undergo malignant transformation. While some individuals with NF1 develop other malignancies, the prevalence of melanoma and other skin cancers is not elevated within this population.

pmc-11673829.title: Drug-Induced Pulmonary Fibrosis: National Database Analysis
pmc-11673829.creator: Olga I Butranova, Elizaveta N Terekhina, Sergey K Zyryanov, Geliia N Gildeeva, Anna A Abramova, Yury O Kustov, Irina L Asetskaya, Vitaly A Polivanov, Michelle Griffin, Derrick Wan, Michael T Longaker
pmc-11673829.description: Background/Objectives: Pulmonary fibrosis (PF) results in a progressive decline of lung function due to scarring. Drugs are among the most common causes of PF. The objective of our study was to reveal the structure of drugs involved in PF development.

pmc-12535388.title: P450 Enzyme LyoI Performs Hydro‐2,2′‐Bifuran Oxidation in the Polyether Ionophore Lysocellin
pmc-12535388.creator: Michelle H Rasmussen, Søren L B Møller, Esben B Svenningsen, Thomas Tørring, Thomas B Poulsen
pmc-12535388.description: Polyether ionophores are potent antimicrobials, albeit also cytotoxic against mammalian cells. We have identified several polyether ionophores containing a common hydro‐2,2′‐bifuran‐2‐ol (hemiketal) moiety, which cannot be derived from the canonical biosynthetic steps observed for the compound class, suggesting an unusual oxidative transformation. To identify the responsible enzyme, we applied CRISPR–BEST to knock out genes in the lysocellin‐producing strain S. longwoodensis.

pmc-12796262.title: Dynamical spin susceptibility and magnetic ordering in a square-octagon lattice in the Hubbard model
pmc-12796262.creator: Mona Abdi, Bandar Astinchap, Erfan Norian
pmc-12796262.description: In this work, we investigate the electronic and magnetic properties of the two-dimensional square-octagon structure (2DSOS) using a tight-binding framework augmented by on-site Coulomb interaction. We examine how varying hopping parameters, magnetic flux, and interaction strength influence the system’s band structure, dynamical transverse spin susceptibility (DTSS), and static spin structure factor (SSSF).

pmc-12860068.title: Bridging iron and lung injury: the emerging role of ferroptosis in ARDS
pmc-12860068.creator: Yuanjun Zhang, Ji Luo, Zhiqiang Tang, Hui Gao
pmc-12860068.description: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is a severe and diffuse inflammatory lung injury induced by various pulmonary or systemic insults. Its characteristics include disruption of the alveolar–capillary barrier, protein-rich exudates, and refractory hypoxemia. It has a high clinical mortality rate and lacks specific therapies targeting the core mechanisms.

pmc-12961183.title: Tailored for swift recognition: A structural perspective on secondary active plant hormone transporters
pmc-12961183.creator: Bjørn Lildal Amsinck, Ines Benhammouche, Adriana Chrenková, Alexander JD Snow, Bjørn Panyella Pedersen
pmc-12961183.description: SUMMARYPlant hormone transporters are essential for regulating phytohormone distribution at the cellular, tissue, and organ levels in plants. These proteins control hormone movement across membranes, shaping the spatial and temporal hormone gradients that underpin growth, development, and stress responses. This review surveys secondary active transporters implicated in the transport of auxin, cytokinin, abscisic acid, and gibberellins.

Real-world data on current diagnostic processes used among diverse populations remains limited.ObjectivesThis study aimed to investigate diagnostic patterns and use of diagnostic tests among U.S.

pmc-12995827.title: A randomized phase III clinical trial of weekly versus tri-weekly cisplatin-based chemoradiotherapy for locally advanced cervical cancer: results of the TACO (GCIG/KGOG 1027/THAI 2012) study
pmc-12995827.creator: S.Y. Ryu, B.H. Nam, M.H. Kim, W.I. Jang, C. Sitathanee, T.D. Linh, K.H. Lee, W.M. Lee, E.T. Kim, S.B. Kang, J.H. Kim, J.Y. Park, K.B. Lee, C.H. Cho, H. Lou, Y.H. Kim, Y.T. Kim, Y.H. Lee, X. Wu, J.W. Kim, S.I. Park, S. Jeon, D.H. Thinh, S.F. Kry, D. Gaffney, W. Small, S. Wilailak
pmc-12995827.description: BackgroundThe standard treatment for locally advanced cervical cancer is cisplatin-based chemoradiotherapy; however, the optimal dose and dosing schedule of cisplatin remain debated. The aim of this study was to compare the clinical outcomes of weekly cisplatin at 40 mg/m2 versus those of tri-weekly cisplatin at 75 mg/m2 during radiation in patients with locally advanced cervical cancer.

pmc-13245695.title: Spatial Distribution and Determinants of Fertility in India
pmc-13245695.creator: Pradeep Deshmukh, Nishaant Ramasamy, Priyanka Yadav, Yogesh Bahurupi
pmc-13245695.description: Background:India has witnessed a fall in fertility rates, but there are regional variations. Spatial planning requires an understanding of the spatial pattern of fertility rates and the factors affecting them. This research was undertaken with the objective of understanding the spatial pattern of total fertility rates and socioeconomic factors in India.

pmc-13372126.title: Non-communicable disease care in peri-urban Nepal: Potential for community-based interventions
pmc-13372126.creator: Maryam Hameed Khan, Yoko Inagaki, Sonam Magar, Sweta Koirala, Nisha Rana, Pabitra Babu Soti, Gabriella Rose Chalker, Kamal Ghimire, Svea Closser, Dinesh Neupane, Katherine Kokkinias, Katherine Kokkinias, Graeme Hoddinott, Katherine Kokkinias, Graeme Hoddinott, Graeme Hoddinott
pmc-13372126.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Non-communicable diseases (NCDs) are a growing public health challenge in Nepal, driven by hypertension, diabetes, and smoking, and contributing substantially to morbidity and mortality. Access to equitable and affordable care remains limited, particularly in community settings. Task-sharing with Female Community Health Volunteers (FCHVs), a national cadre of volunteer community health workers primarily engaged in maternal and child health, offers a potential strategy to improve community-based NCD management, but its feasibility requires careful assessment.

pmc-13500864.title: 雌二醇 -ER β信号轴通过调控M2型巨噬细胞分泌IGF -1促进雌鼠急性骨骼肌炎肌纤维修复

pmc-13500864.description: 目的雌激素的主要成分为雌二醇，在组织损伤修复中的作用因组织的再生能力而异。在具有强大再生潜能的骨骼肌中，其作用机制尚不明确。本研究旨在探究雌二醇信号对心脏毒素(cardiotoxin，CTX)诱导的小鼠急性骨骼肌炎中肌纤维再生修复的影响。方法在体实验：选取野生C57BL/6雄鼠80只、雌鼠205只，对75只雌鼠进行卵巢去势(ovariectomized，OVX)。CTX诱导小鼠急性骨骼肌炎后，给予β-雌二醇(β-estradiol)、4-[2-苯基-5,7-双(三氟甲基)吡唑并[1,5-a]嘧啶-3-基]苯酚{4-[2-phenyl-5,7-bis(trifluoromethyl)pyrazolo[1,5-a]-pyrimidin-3-yl]phenol，PHTPP}等试剂肌肉注射，将小鼠分为control、β-estradiol、PHTPP、OVX、OVX+β-estradiol组。酶联免疫吸附分析(enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay，ELISA)法比较各组小鼠血清中雌二醇、肌酸激酶(creatine kinase，CK)表达；实时反转录聚合酶链反应(real-time reverse transcription PCR，real-time RT-PCR)检测雌鼠损伤肌内单核细胞趋化蛋白-1(monocyte chemoattractant protein-1，MCP-1)、白细胞介素(interleukin，IL)-13的信使RNA(messenger RNA，mRNA)表达；real-time RT-PCR、蛋白质印迹法(Western blotting，WB)检测损伤肌内雌激素受体(estrogen receptor，ER)α、ERβ、G蛋白偶联受体(G-protein coupled receptor，GPR )30的表达；流式细胞术检测雌鼠损伤肌内巨噬细胞(macrophage，Mac)表型与表达胰岛素样生长因子-1(insulin-like growth factor-1，IGF-1)、肝细胞生长因子(hepatocyte growth factor，HGF)的M2型Mac比例；免疫荧光检测雌鼠单核/Mac的浸润、磷酸化IGF-1受体(phosphorylated insulin-like growth factor 1 receptor，p-IGF-1R)、胚胎型肌球蛋白重链(embryonic myosin heavy chain，eMHC)的表达。细胞实验：用2%马血清(horse serum，HS)分化培养C2C12小鼠成肌细胞72 h，C2C12小鼠成肌细胞为成熟肌管后，给予γ干扰素(interferon gamma，IFN-γ)、β-estradiol、PHTPP等处理24 h。分为单独培养体系与共培养体系。单独培养体系，主要分为control(C2C12+HS)、IFN-γ、IFN-γ+β-estradiol、IFN-γ+PHTPP、IFN-γ+β-estradiol+PHTPP组。WB检测单独培养体系中C2C12细胞的细胞间充质-上皮转化因子(cellular mesenchymal-epithelial transition factor，c-Met)、p-IGF-1R、配对盒蛋白7(paired box protein 7，Pax7)等蛋白质的表达水平。共培养体系，经IFN-γ、β-estradiol、PHTPP等处理24 h后，将C2C12细胞与小鼠腹腔Mac共培养4 h，主要分为control(C2C12+HS+Mac)、IFN-γ、IFN-γ+β-estradiol、IFN-γ+ PHTPP、IFN-γ+β-estradiol+PHTPP组。流式细胞术检测Mac表型、表达HGF或IGF-1的M2型Mac比例；WB检测共培养体系中C2C12细胞c-Met、p-IGF-1R、Pax7的蛋白质表达水平。结果在体实验显示，雌鼠血清雌二醇与损伤肌内ERβ水平均显著高于雄鼠(均 P<0.05)；与control组比较，OVX组损伤肌内表达IGF-1的M2型Mac比例、eMHC与p-IGF-1R的表达、 IL-13的mRNA表达均显著下调(均 P<0.05)。细胞实验显示，在单独培养体系中，各组C2C12细胞c-Met、p-IGF-1R、Pax7蛋白表达的差异均无统计学意义(均 P>0.05)；在共培养体系中，与IFN-γ组比较，IFN-γ+β-estradiol组表达IGF-1的M2型Mac比例与C2C12细胞的p-IGF-1R、Pax7均显著上调(均 P<0.05)；IFN-γ+PHTPP组趋势相反( P<0.
